pages.text: Yes, now you just can't walk on the cold tundra or in a Cave with a bare fifth point. Therefore, you need ways to protect yourself from extreme temperatures.

pages.title: Temperature interface
pages.text: The shard in the middle is the player's current temperature.
The element on the right is the ambient temperature. Without a thermometer, you can only roughly know the temperature.
The thermometer shows the exact temperature.
pages.title: Thermometer
Thermometer
pages.text: An extremely useful tool when working in difficult conditions.
